channel.title: CyberAidAU Updates
channel.description: Pathway progress updates from CyberAidAU — real milestones on the way to taking on clients.

item.title: CyberAidAU secure business foundation
item.description: Developing security-by-design controls before services launch, including separated client-file stages, isolated security-lab environments, approval controls for sensitive actions and clear data-handling boundaries.

item.title: Network firewall design and testing
item.description: Completed a Cisco Packet Tracer network-defence simulation using EIGRP routing, access-control policies, Context-Based Access Control and a Zone-Based Policy Firewall.

item.title: Grey-box scanning in an isolated practice network
item.description: Completed a controlled university laboratory using Kali Linux, a deliberately vulnerable target and Nmap to identify hosts, open ports, services and likely outdated components.

item.title: Hands-on vulnerability assessment training
item.description: Working through Hack The Box Academy's Vulnerability Assessment module, then applying it directly — running full practice assessments against a self-built lab environment, start to finish.
